findings.claim: The zh sizing clause used when the percent-risk cap cannot apply says the position has no entry price, even when it has one and only the invalidation price is missing or not below entry.
findings.evidence: kuroshio/core/allocator/engine.py CARD_TEXT['zh']['tw_base_no_stop']; target_weight() picks it when entry is None OR invalidation is None OR invalidation >= entry; a holding with entry_price set and no invalidation_price is told it has no entry price.
findings.repro: target_weight(make_ips(caps.position_pct=10), Holding(ticker='NOW', weight=0.06, entry_price=101.885), _text('zh'))[2] contains '沒有進場價'; test_hard_cap_trim_zh_base_cap_no_stop only covers a holding with neither price.
findings.acceptance: For a holding with an entry_price but no invalidation_price below it, the zh clause no longer claims the entry price is missing; a zh test with entry_price set and invalidation_price None (or >= entry) asserts it.

verifications.evidence: tw_base_no_stop reworded to negate the entry+invalidation pair; two new zh tests cover invalidation None / == entry / > entry with entry_price set; 413/413 at f35376d
